question: Can head/left psychic targeting and a medkit body slot reuse native target/use policy without writing the shared camera or healing manually?
claim: Steam area and individual psi targeting read the 24-byte IArkPlayer reticle getter; scoped output replacement can separate psi aim from the weapon cache. The individual HUD-preferred candidate bypasses its angle test and must use the ordinary angle test in the VR scope. The native medkit helper resolves a 64-bit medkit archetype and ConsumeItem performs native inventory lookup, CanConsume and UseFromInventory, returning absent/refused/use-invoked outcomes.
method: EGS symbols were correspondence leads only. Explicit /Prey/PreyDll.dll Steam Ghidra target; memory getter cross-check; Python 3.12 read-only verify_psi_medkit.py proves exact SHA, x64, 18 whole bodies including split unwind spans, absence of relocations, 54 mutation controls, vtable/getter/candidate and native transaction witnesses. MSVC 2026 Release and CTest production-mock adapters are separate offline harness evidence. Reproduce: python -E -B tools/re/verify_psi_medkit.py; cmake --build build/psi-medkit --config Release; ctest --test-dir build/psi-medkit -C Release --output-on-failure.
